<title level="1" right="Action">[Repeat a Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2628) <actions string="" /></title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Exploration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=595" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 439

</column>

---

You repeatedly cast the same spell while moving at half speed. Typically, this spell is a [cantrip](/Traits.aspx?ID=22) that you want to have in effect in the event a combat breaks out, and it must be one you can cast in 2 actions or fewer. Repeating a spell that requires making complex decisions, such as [_figment_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1528), can make you [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=15), as determined by the GM.
name: Repeat a Spell
